scope: Selected only from the unchanged source light and receiver geometry, prior to any candidate optics. Signed shadow check is only against the authored opaque 30931-triangle church; misses do not assert unobstructed sky for all objects. Screen visibility remains unproven for each ray before actual depth/owner verification. World absolute game XYZ. Native material vs area thresholds are separate.
method: Each label begins at the lexicographically least SHA-256(label:XYZ-5-decimals) among qualified samples and farthest-point XY thereafter. Real top samples >0.35m inside visible paving (inside shadow >=0.30m, misses 0.65–2.5m from shadow). Curb barycentric weights all >=.06, .016–.059m above ground, only strongly illuminated or negative-facing normals. Ground samples 0.5m–1.0m from a true caster boundary and >=1m inside free ground; normals there are actual facet normals, rendered vertex-based shading normal can differ. Distances start at true +2mm ray origin specified per record. Ground triangle IDs are ordinals into signed rooted local N112 triangle list, cast IDs are source global true triangles.
